verses.text: For the music director. To be played on stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph. A song. God is known in Judah. His name is great in Israel.
His tent is in Salem. His home is in Zion.
There he broke the flaming arrows, the shields and swords, and the weapons of war. Selah.
You shine with glory. You are more majestic than mountains full of prey.
Brave soldiers have been robbed. They lie in the sleep of death. None of the warriors can lift a hand.
When you shouted at them, God of Jacob, both horses and chariots fell into a deep sleep.
You alone are to be feared. Who can stand in front of you when you are angry?
From heaven you announced your judgment. The earth was afraid and was silent
when you, God, rose up to judge and to save all the suffering people of the earth. Selah.
Even human anger ends up praising you. Those who survive your anger are held back.
Make promises to the LORD your God and keep them. Let all the nations around bring gifts to the one who should be feared.
He breaks the pride of rulers. The kings of the earth are afraid of him.
